description: Data pipeline, CLI, trainer and main.py wiring (design 5.1, 5.3, 5.4, 7.1 trainer/cascade/args/main tests; OD5/OD6). LinearPipeline gets an optional uint8 label reader (DALI order images, T[, Rt], labels[, G, version]); LinearDataModule gets `synth_label_set`; `--synth-*` flags + validation + `synth_config_from_args`; TrainConfig.synth; Trainer routes every post-process call through `_pp_call`, linear step signatures carry the uint8 label spec and four NEW lambdas (labels keyword-only into `body`, `skip` positional as today), synth logging, checkpointed synth generator, BN-recal synthetic slots; main.py writes the `synth` record only when on and guards resume. Includes the local e2e tiny trainer runs (p 0 and p 1, rigid+affine+deform, level 4) with trace count 1. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: data_loading/dali_loader.py (must import without DALI): `linear_output_signature(task, level, batch_size, control=False, labels=False)` inserts the label entry (shape (n,)+LEVEL_SHAPE+(1,), dtype 'uint8') after T/Rt and before the control extras; `base_output_count(task, labels=False)` (+1); `output_count(task, residual_affine=False, labels=False)` (linear only; deform unchanged). `LinearPipeline.__init__(..., control_file=None, label_files=None)`: with labels: lengths must match (ValueError), shuffle_mode must be 'epoch' (ValueError mirroring check_deform_inputs; put the pure-Python check in a helper `check_linear_label_inputs(files, label_files, shuffle_mode)` so it is testable without DALI), both lists permuted with the SAME `paired_permutation(len, seed)` (identical to today's RandomState permutation of files). `define_graph`: images/matrices/warp/aug exactly as today; with labels a label reader `_reader_to_gpu(numpy_reader_kwargs(self.label_files, self.file_root, self.shuffle, 'epoch', seed=self.reader_seed, name=LABEL_READER_NAME), self.volume_shape, types.UINT8)` created AFTER the random ops, NOT warped; output `(imgs, t_fwd[, rt], labels) + extra`. `output_signature()` passes labels. Docstring update (outputs list).

data_loading/data_module.py: `LinearDataModule(..., synth_label_set=None)`; property `synth_label_files` (`manifest_files(self.rows, self.level, split=None, kind='labels', label_set=self.synth_label_set, contrast=self.contrast)`, cached; resolved eagerly in __init__ when the set is given so a missing file is a startup ValueError naming the case); `pipeline(task)`: with a set, linear pipelines get `label_files=self.synth_label_files` and the deform pipeline gets `self.synth_label_files` instead of `self.label_files`; None = today's code path exactly.

runtime/args.py: new flags in the augmentation group: `--synth-prob` (float, default 0.0), `--synth-jitter` (0.08), `--synth-device` (choices gpu|cpu, default gpu), `--synth-label-set` (default synthfine), `--synth-hier-dev-cortex` (float, default 0.25; OD1), help texts citing design 5.4. parse_args validation (parser.error, exit 2): prob finite in [0, 1]; jitter finite in [0, 0.5]; hier-dev-cortex finite in [0, 0.5]; label set matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$; p > 0 requires `intensity_aug_device(args) in ('tf', 'off')` (DALI aug would be overwritten), refuses --overfit-one-group and --shuffle-mode buffer. `synth_config_from_args(args)` -> None when getattr(args, 'synth_prob', 0.0) == 0 (older Namespaces without synth fields -> None) else `P.SynthConfig(prob, jitter, device, label_set, hier_dev_cortex=...)` (other fields default). `train_config_from_args` passes `synth=synth_config_from_args(args)`. Module docstring bullet. Must stay TF-free at import.

runtime/run.py: `TrainConfig.synth: Optional[object] = None` (comment: design 5.3). In Trainer.__init__ pass `synth=cfg.synth` to both post-process constructors; `self._synth_on = cfg.synth is not None` set BEFORE rebuild_steps(). `checkpoint_variables`: add `postprocess_<t>_synth` when `pp.synth_generator is not None`. Add `_pp_call(self, task, inputs, synth_override=None)` exactly as design 5.3 (deform: pp(*inputs, **kw); off: pp(*inputs); linear on: n = 3 rigid / 2 affine, pp(*inputs[:n], labels=inputs[n], **kw)). `_make_train_step`: `shapes, dtypes = dali_loader.linear_output_signature(task, level, N, labels=self._synth_on)`; signature = float32 specs when off (today's line) and `tf.as_dtype(d)` specs when on; `body(images, t_dali, rt_dali=None, skip=None, *, labels=None)` calls `self._pp_call(task, [images, t_dali] + ([rt_dali] if task == 'rigid' else []) + ([labels] if self._synth_on else []))`; the four existing lambdas stay byte-identical for the off path; with synthesis on use the four lambdas of design 5.3 (rigid+cascade `lambda images, t_dali, rt_dali, labels, skip: body(images, t_dali, rt_dali, skip, labels=labels)`, affine+cascade `lambda images, t_dali, labels, skip: body(images, t_dali, None, skip, labels=labels)`, rigid `lambda images, t_dali, rt_dali, labels: body(images, t_dali, rt_dali, labels=labels)`, affine `lambda images, t_dali, labels: body(images, t_dali, None, labels=labels)`). `_make_deform_step` body: `batch = self._pp_call(task, [images, labels] + ([t_dali] if residual else []))` (identical call on the off path). Both bodies: when on, `res['synth'] = tf.cast(batch['synth'], tf.float32)`. `split_batch`: `output_count(task, cfg.deform_residual_affine, labels=self._synth_on and task != DEFORM)`. `fit`: when 'synth' in res, `acc.update({'train_<t>/synth_frac': res['synth']})` for EVERY executed step (finite or not, so its window mean is weighted like window_steps; OD2) and, for finite steps, `train_<t>/loss_synth` or `train_<t>/loss_real` with res['loss']; `rec['synth']` kept in history. Module-level `synth_recal_slot(b, p)` = floor((b + 1) p) > floor(b p) (Python floats; exact counts floor(K p)). `_recal_input(self, task, inputs, synth_override=None)` uses `self._pp_call(task, inputs, synth_override)`. `recalibrate_bn`: per-task slot counter b_t; with synthesis on pass `synth_override=synth_recal_slot(b_t, cfg.synth.prob)`, else None (today's call); event gains `synth_batches` {t: planned floor(K_t p)} and `synth_batches_used` {t: used synthetic slots} ONLY when on.

main.py: `_build_dali_data` passes `synth_label_set=args.synth_label_set` to LinearDataModule only when `A.synth_config_from_args(args)` is not None (default call unchanged) and appends ' | synth p

missing set -> ValueError naming the case; DALI-free: construct LinearDataModule only if it needs no DALI, else test manifest_files directly). tests/test_runtime_infra.py: the 5.4 validation table (each bad value -> SystemExit 2; p>0 with --intensity-aug-device dali, --overfit-one-group, --shuffle-mode buffer refused; --intensity-aug false allowed), synth_config_from_args None by default and for a Namespace without synth fields, values passed through incl. hier_dev_cortex. tests/test_main.py: `_check_synth_config` cases (missing key = off OK, off vs on exit, field difference exit), config.json of a default run has no top-level 'synth' and args gains the five synth_* defaults only (follow the existing config tests in that module). tests/test_trainer.py new class `TestSynthTrainer(DeformCase)`: fixed sources built from `fine_labels_from_train18` groups (linear tuples (images, T, Rt, labels) / (images, T, labels); deform (images, fine labels)); (a) e2e: TrainConfig(task_ratio rigid:1, affine:1, deform:2, synth=SynthConfig(prob=1.0)) fit ~8 steps with a seed covering all tasks (`_seed_with_all_tasks`): every loss finite, trace_counts == {rigid: 1, affine: 1, deform: 1}, history synth == 1.0 for all, window logs contain train_<t>/synth_frac 1 and loss_synth; (b) the same with prob 0.5 and a fixed seed giving both outcomes: trace counts 1, synth_frac in (0, 1), loss_real and loss_synth logged; (c) p 0 / synth None run: identical histories to a trainer built without the field (bit-equal losses); (d) checkpoint round trip incl. `postprocess_<t>_synth` (restore -> next draws equal); default trainer has no `_synth` keys; (e) `_pp_call` unit test (on: labels reach `labels=`; off: pp(*inputs); linear on without labels -> ValueError); (f) OneHot-depth multiset on the traced train steps (deform and linear) on vs off (same helper as tests/test_synth.py; import it from there). tests/test_cascade.py: new `TestSynthSkip(CascadeTrainerCase)` = the forced-skip comparison of TestSkip::test_graph_and_forced_skip with synthesis p 1 for both trainers (same seed; exercises the new lambdas) and the level-1 chain twin in the ChainCase style if feasible; new `TestSynthRecal(CascadeTrainerCase)`: recalibrate_bn with rigid AND affine AND deform at p 1 -> every slot synthetic (spy on `_pp_call` / batch['synth'] True, images differ from real), planned/used counts == batches; with a forced `synth_override=False` path the batch equals the synthesis-off post-process (catches labels landing in rt_dali / flip_axes); `synth_recal_slot` counts for K in {1, 16, 64} x p in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1} == floor(K p) and interleaved.
Run the cascade-skip guards UNCHANGED: tests.test_cascade.TestSkip, TestChainTrainer, TestStageSkipLevel2, TestStageSkipChain, TestBNRecal must pass without edits to their bodies.
Append all commands and results (test counts, golden diffs, the e2e numbers: per-task final losses and trace counts for p 0 and p 1) to .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/impl-log.md.

Verification: tf_gpu group (data_loading, runtime_infra, main, postprocess, synth) 173 OK (3 DALI skips); tests.test_trainer 74 OK, both goldens max |diff| 0; tests.test_cascade 52 OK (guards unchanged); bgr_preproc38 py_compile + ast 3.8 (75 files), main.py --help and TF-free runtime.args OK. Details + e2e numbers in impl-log.md. Deviations / notes: (1) `Trainer._synth_on = any(pp.synth is not None for pp in postprocess)` instead of `cfg.synth is not None`: the post-processes treat SynthConfig(prob=0) as off (FEAT-002), so a TrainConfig with prob 0 stays on today's path (signatures, no 'synth' key) instead of expecting a batch['synth'] that never exists; main.py / synth_config_from_args pass None at p 0 anyway. (2) `_pp_call` raises ValueError('synthesis on: the <task> post-process needs the label input ...') when a linear input list has no label entry (instead of an IndexError). (3) `_check_synth_config` compares the JSON round trip of asdict(SynthConfig) (tuples -> lists) with the saved record. (4) BN-recal event `synth_batches` = floor(plan.count(t) * p) per task, `synth_batches_used` counts slots with override True whose batch was used (non-finite slots excluded). For FEAT-004 (checker / scripts): metrics.jsonl window records carry `train_<t>/synth_frac` (mean over EVERY executed step of the window, finite or not, so weight by `train_<t>/window_steps`), `train_<t>/loss_synth` / `train_<t>/loss_real` (finite steps only; a key is absent from a window with no such step); the `bn_recalibration` event gains `synth_batches` {t: floor(K_t p)} and `synth_batches_used` {t: n} only with synthesis on; config.json top-level `synth` = asdict(SynthConfig) (keys prob, jitter, std_max, fwhm_mr_mm, fwhm_pet_mm, pet_family_prob, fwhm_image_jitter, bias_grid, bias_std_max, gamma_log_std, noise_std_max, remask_prob, hier_dev, hier_dev_cortex, norm_quantile, device, label_set) only when on; config.json args always lists synth_prob / synth_jitter / synth_device / synth_label_set / synth_hier_dev_cortex. main.py flags: --synth-prob P --synth-jitter J --synth-device gpu|cpu --synth-label-set NAME --synth-hier-dev-cortex X; p > 0 needs --intensity-aug-device tf (or --intensity-aug false) -> the r_level scripts must keep INTENSITY_AUG_DEVICE=tf (or equivalent) when SYNTH_PROB != 0; refused with --shuffle-mode buffer / --overfit-one-group. Data: with p > 0 LinearDataModule(synth_label_set=...) resolves labels_<set>_<k>.npy for every train row at startup (ValueError naming the case if the synthfine export is missing) and the deform pipeline reads the fine labels instead of train18. For FEAT-005 (eval): `Trainer._pp_call(task, inputs, synth_override)` is the single post-process entry; the validation path is untouched; test helpers `tests.test_trainer.fine_label_group(level, n, seed)` (synthfine [n, X, Y, Z, 1] from label phantoms) and `tests.test_synth.onehot_depths(fn, *args)`. Local timing: tests.test_trainer ~73 min, tests.test_cascade ~62 min, the 5-module group ~80 min (test_main overfit tests dominate) on the GTX 1080.
